The '''Kura City Guard''' was the local [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]]. They investigated the kidnapping of famous singer [[Ledina Chott]]. [[Detective Sergeant]] [[Husin]] and [[Detective/Legends|Detective]] [[Biller]] were [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] with the Guard.
